notes.title: Version 760 released!
notes.notes:
Version 760 is live.
Featuring a bunch of fixes and most importantly a difficulty selector straight at the start.

notes.title: Version 0.527
notes.notes:
This build brings the first two important optimization pieces of work:

1) For PCs with dual video card (like many laptops that boast Nvidia GPUs) the game will now automatically run on the discrete (fast) one, so no more manual fiddling with the video driver's settings .

2) Massive optimization of the particle systems. This will not immediately reflect on the current state of the game, but will allow us to add a lot more particle effects to the levels and scenes. In the Linux version they were actually buggy and disabled, but with this patch they work well there too.

notes.title: Version 0.523b
notes.notes:
Minor usability improvements.
The card stealing section in the mansion dungeon is now easier and more consistent.

notes.title: Version 0.521
notes.notes: We added a keyboard controls reconfigurator to the main menu!

notes.title: Version 0.520
notes.notes:
This version brings support to Steam Input, meaning full gamepad support on both Windows and Linux, but... although it works for the full version of the game (which is not released yet), I haven't been able to convince Steam that playtest also supports it.
This means that the build has everything needed to make it work, but there's something missing on the Steamworks settings side of things.

As a side effect, the Xbox gamepads that were working on Windows in the previous builds now stopped working completely.

notes.title: Version 0.519 - Windows
notes.notes:
1) Improved Keyboard controls
2) Increased deadly fall height (he's a feline after all)
3) Improved intro music

notes.title: Repackage Linux executable
notes.notes: This Linux patch should solve the start failure on a bunch of older systems / SteamDeck

notes.title: Version 0.519 - Linux
notes.notes:
This was a small Linux patch that features the following improvements suggested by the community:
1) Improved Keyboard controls
2) increase deadly fall height (he's a feline after all)
3) Solved slowdown issue in Sewers section by temporarily disabling mud pipes
4) Improved intro music

More to come, stay tuned!
